r0.why: Only land plants in sea [1], returned to ocean 70-100 Mya [3,27], name from narrow leaves, rhizome spread, grassland-like meadows [4].

r1.why: Autotrophic photosynthesis in photic zone, shallow sheltered sand/mud [5]; ~60 species [2], low diversity yet all continents but Antarctica [30]; productive meadows [9].

r2.why: Underwater pollination, life cycle, seeds [6,12,13]; current-drift belief false for Thalassia testudinum [7]; crabs, polychaete larvae, nutritious mucigenous pollen clumps instead of nectar [8].

r3.why: Reduced cuticle, stomata-less photosynthetic epidermis [14]; anoxic roots, oxygen from leaves/rhizomes, nutrient transfer [15]; genomes show stomatal genes lost [31,32]; radical cell wall change [33].

r4.why: Carbon sinks, diversity comparable to coral reefs [10]; breeding/nursery, fisheries [17]; profoundly influence coastal environments [16].

r5.why: Worldwide decline [19]; ten species, 14%, three endangered [20]; repercussions for marine biodiversity and people [21].
